datasets.name: World - HGT terrain (automatic Mapzen Skadi tile download)
datasets.verticalDatum: EGM96 for Mapzen downloads; user-supplied files may differ
datasets.attribution: Mapzen Terrain Tiles and contributing data providers
notes: Local .hgt files take precedence over downloaded .hgt.gz files.
Mapzen Skadi is a heterogeneous global composite and should not be treated as a uniform survey or a uniform 30 m product.

datasets.name: World - GEDTM30 bare-earth terrain (30 m automatic range download)
datasets.attribution: GEDTM30 v20250619 by Yu-Feng Ho and Tomislav Hengl, distributed by OpenTopography
datasets.information: GEDTM30 is a machine-learning-derived global bare-earth terrain model. TSRE downloads only the compressed COG blocks needed for the requested area; it does not download the roughly 261 GB source file. Validate the model independently before engineering or other critical use.
notes: The source is a near-global 0.00025 degree Int32 COG with a 0.1 metre value scale. TSRE range-reads its index tables and only the required Deflate-compressed 2048 by 2048 blocks.
Coverage in this published COG ends near 57 degrees south and excludes Antarctica; the configured world HGT source remains available as fallback outside coverage or at voids.
The native spacing is appropriate for future distant-terrain use, but that workflow still requires a separate practical validation.

datasets.name: Austria - BEV ALS DTM 1 m (range COG)
datasets.attribution: BEV and Austrian public geodata providers - ALS DTM 1 m
notes: The 2025 national mosaic is distributed as 50 km BigTIFF COG tiles. TSRE downloads only the required internal compressed blocks by HTTP range and can also window-read a complete user-supplied TIFF with the official file name.

The files are Float32, LZW-compressed, use the floating-point predictor and contain overviews. This first integration uses the native 1 m image; explicit distant-terrain overview selection remains separate work.
The URL contains the BEV annual publication date. A later annual mosaic should be introduced by updating this catalogue entry so its cache remains version-identifiable.
BEV documents an older 2021 series using the Adriatic/Trieste height reference. This entry selects the 2025 EVRF2000 Austria series.

datasets.name: Slovakia - GKÚ DMR 5.0 terrain 1 m (range COG)
datasets.attribution: Geodesy, Cartography and Cadastre Authority of the Slovak Republic - DMR 5.0
datasets.information: National 1 m LiDAR terrain model. TSRE reads only required blocks from a TSRE-hosted COG conversion of the official national TIFF. Heights are ETRS89 ellipsoidal and are not converted to an orthometric datum.
notes: The converted national BigTIFF uses 1024 x 1024 Deflate Float32 tiles with floating-point prediction and eight internal overviews. TSRE downloads only the compressed blocks required for the terrain.
EPSG:3046 uses the same GRS80 Transverse Mercator parameters as ETRS89 / UTM zone 34N; GeoTIFF raster X/Y remains easting/northing despite the formal CRS axis declaration.

The source's ETRS89 ellipsoidal heights do not match HGT or GEDTM30 orthometric heights. A constant source offset can tune a local area, but a future vertical grid is required for a national conversion.
Detailed-source distant terrain use remains disabled pending explicit overview selection and validation.

datasets.name: Belgium - Wallonia SPW terrain 1 m (range COG)
datasets.information: Wallonia's 1 m bare-earth terrain model from the 2021-2022 LiDAR survey. TSRE reads only required blocks from a TSRE-hosted COG conversion of the official national TIFF.
notes: The converted national BigTIFF uses 1024 x 1024 Deflate Float32 tiles with floating-point prediction and eight internal overviews. This replaces the source TIFF's impractical full-country-width strip layout.
EPSG:3812 uses the GRS80 Lambert Conformal Conic 2SP definition and requires no horizontal datum grid for this terrain workflow.
The raster stores DNG orthometric heights and -9999 as NoData; zero remains a valid measured elevation.
Detailed-source distant terrain use remains disabled pending explicit overview selection and validation.

datasets.name: Luxembourg - ACT DTM 2024 (1 m COG overview)
datasets.attribution: Administration du cadastre et de la topographie Luxembourg - DTM 2024, CC0
notes: The published national COG is about 40 GB at 0.5 m. TSRE selects its exact 1 m internal overview and downloads only the required compressed blocks plus the COG index tables; it never downloads the complete file automatically.
The source overview is LZW-compressed Float64. Samples are converted to TSRE's Float32 elevation buffer after decoding.
EPSG:2169 conversion uses the official ACT ETRF2000 to LUREF2020 Molodensky-Badekas parameters and Luxembourg TM definition.
This detailed source is not enabled for distant terrain.

datasets.name: Wales - Welsh Government LiDAR DTM 1 m (range COG)
datasets.attribution: Welsh Government LiDAR, Open Government Licence; OSTN15/OSGM15 Lite by Ordnance Survey
notes: The official 32-bit national DTM COG is about 48.6 GB. TSRE downloads only the required Deflate-compressed 256 x 256 blocks and COG index tables.
The 1 m EPSG:27700 source uses Ordnance Survey's OSTN15/OSGM15 Lite 20 km shift grid. TSRE downloads the small official developer archive on first use and stores only its grid under assets/geo.
Ordnance Survey reports 0.08 m horizontal RMS for the Lite grid against the full OSTN15 model, which is comfortably below the source raster spacing.
This detailed source is not enabled for distant terrain.

datasets.name: Sweden - Lantmäteriet Markhöjdmodell 1 m (authenticated STAC/COG)
datasets.license: Swedish valuable datasets terms (CC0 1.0 equivalent open use; retain source attribution)
datasets.information: This national 1 m terrain model requires a free Lantmäteriet product permission. Store its Basic Authentication username and password in the TSRE secrets profile. TSRE queries the public STAC catalogue and authenticates only the required COG byte-range requests.
notes: The STAC catalogue reports compound EPSG:5845 (SWEREF 99 TM plus RH 2000). TSRE validates that published asset metadata while transforming horizontal coordinates with EPSG:3006.

Lantmäteriet currently publishes cloud-optimized GeoTIFF assets. TSRE keeps a revision-specific cache of only the compressed internal blocks needed for the requested terrain and never stores credentials in URLs or cache metadata.
The service documents 10 km by 10 km file coverage; individual STAC assets may use smaller subdivisions. Root STAC search keeps this layout out of terrain-generation code.
This detailed source is not approved for distant terrain.

datasets.name: Switzerland and Liechtenstein - swissALTI3D 2 m (swisstopo STAC/COG)
datasets.attribution: Federal Office of Topography swisstopo - swissALTI3D
notes: STAC exposes 0.5 m and 2 m files. TSRE selects only the 2 m EPSG:2056 COG asset because finer data provide no useful terrain-grid benefit and are much larger.
The catalogue contains historical items for the same 1 km footprint. TSRE selects the newest item per footprint and preserves each approximately 1 MB source COG under the readable dataset directory.
The local EPSG:2056 forward conversion uses the official swisstopo approximation with published horizontal accuracy better than one metre across Switzerland.

STAC discovery includes a small interpolation margin and prepared tiles are joined on their common 2 m grid. Bilinear sampling at a 1 km file boundary therefore uses source pixels from both tiles instead of invoking HGT fallback along the seam.
The 1 km asset layout is not suitable for 32 km distant terrain and is not enabled for that workflow.

datasets.name: Portugal - DGT LiDAR DTM 2 m (user-managed files)
datasets.attribution: Direção-Geral do Território (DGT) - mainland Portugal LiDAR DTM
datasets.information: DGT currently requires a registered Data Centre login for raster downloads. Download MDT-2m GeoTIFF tiles in the portal and copy them to the local directory shown above. TSRE indexes their embedded georeferencing and uses every file that overlaps the requested terrain.
notes: The 2024-2025 DTM is distributed as 1 km x 1 km GeoTIFF tiles. The 2 m product contains 500 x 500 Float32 samples per tile and uses -999 as NoData.

Raster download remains protected by the CDD web-login session. This entry is fully local after the user downloads files; it never submits or stores DGT credentials and never downloads raster assets automatically.
EPSG:3763 conversion uses the official PT-TM06/ETRS89 GRS80 Transverse Mercator definition.
This detailed source is not approved for distant terrain.

datasets.name: Poland - Geoportal NMT 1 m (KRON86, GeoTIFF)
Poland - GUGiK NMT 1 m (EVRF2007, source sheets)
datasets.information: TSRE searches the official GUGiK WFS sheet catalogue, downloads the newest available 1 m EVRF2007 source sheets for the requested terrain and converts them once to local tiled GeoTIFF cache files.

datasets.name: Czechia - CUZK DMR 4G (5 m, EVRS)
Czechia - CUZK DMR 5G (2 m, Bpv)
USA - USGS 3DEP CONUS (2 m request grid)
Norway - Kartverket NHM DTM 1 m
France - IGN MNT LiDAR HD (1 m request grid)
datasets.attribution: IGN - MNT LiDAR HD, Licence Ouverte 2.0
datasets.information: The bare-earth MNT LiDAR HD is natively published at 0.5 m. TSRE requests anonymous numeric GeoTIFF blocks resampled by the official WMS to a 1 m grid. Published coverage is still represented by the service and may contain NoData inside the conservative mainland bounds.
notes: The wms-r raw elevation layer returns single-band Float32 GeoTIFFs for arbitrary EPSG:2154 bounding boxes; it is not the hillshade layer.
A live TSRE probe returned a 1026 by 1026 uncompressed Float32 block at 1 m. A four-block probe reused one cached block and downloaded the other three concurrently in 7.1 seconds.
Lambert-93 uses the shared ellipsoidal Lambert Conformal Conic 2SP conversion on GRS80. Heights remain in IGN69; no vertical datum conversion is applied.
This first profile is metropolitan France. Overseas LiDAR HD layers use different native CRSs and should be separate catalogue entries.

datasets.name: Spain - IGN/CNIG MDT05 (5 m)
Slovenia - GURS DMR1 (1 m)
Germany - Brandenburg + Berlin DGM1 (1 m)
Germany - Nordrhein-Westfalen DGM1 (1 m)
Germany - Hessen DGM1 (1 m)
Germany - Baden-Wurttemberg DGM1 (1 m)
notes: Research 2026-09-19: both WCS 1 and WCS 2 return UInt16 whole-metre heights. The 1 m resolution describes horizontal spacing; switching WCS versions does not recover fractional heights.
WCS 2 requires E/N subset axes but X/Y scaling axes. At native resolution it also returned 1025 x 1026 for a requested 1026 x 1026 block; retain WCS 1 for its correct output grid.
Shared downsampling softens quantization but cannot restore source precision. Investigate original DGM1 XYZ or raster tile downloads for better heights; the separate official sample is Float32.
Reproducible requests and findings: docs/tasks/geo/baden-wurttemberg-wcs-research.md.

datasets.name: Germany - Sachsen-Anhalt DGM1 (1 m)
Finland - NLS Elevation Model 2 m
datasets.attribution: National Land Survey of Finland - Elevation Model 2 m, CC BY 4.0
notes: Requires geo.elevation.fi.nls.apiKey in profile-local secrets.json. TSRE sends the key as the HTTP Basic username with an empty password; catalogue and cache metadata contain no key value.
Native EPSG:3067 (ETRS-TM35FIN) is already supported by the shared local TM conversion. Keep native 2 m spacing; server-side reprojection is unnecessary.
Authenticated probes confirmed default uncompressed Float32 GeoTIFF at 2 m. Do not add uppercase GEOTIFF:* options: the service gateway rejected each tested option with an HTTP 200 HTML page.
Elevation requests are limited to 10000 x 10000 m and a maximum scaled width/height of 5000 pixels.
Bounds are conservative Finland-wide EPSG:3067 bounds. Actual 2 m coverage has some gaps in the outer archipelago and along parts of the eastern border.

datasets.name: Netherlands - AHN DTM (1 m)
notes: Native horizontal CRS is EPSG:28992 (RD New); heights remain NAP (EPSG:5709). PDOK performs horizontal reprojection to EPSG:25831 (ETRS89 / UTM 31N), already supported locally. No vertical datum conversion is requested.

The 1 m spacing and conservative bounds describe the EPSG:25831 request/cache grid. PDOK resamples the native 0.5 m RD grid on the server; TSRE downloads and caches 1 m data, using approximately one quarter as many pixels for the same area.
SUBSETTINGCRS/OUTPUTCRS and uncompressed TIFF options are configured in the endpoint query. Live probes on 2026-09-19 confirmed Float32 output and exact requested UTM grid dimensions.
No API key or authentication is required.
Zero and negative elevations are valid NAP heights, so zeroIsNoData must remain false.

datasets.name: England - Environment Agency LIDAR Composite DTM 1 m (2 m request grid)
datasets.attribution: Environment Agency - LIDAR Composite DTM, Open Government Licence v3.0
notes: Native source is a 1 m DTM in EPSG:27700 (British National Grid). The WCS 2.0.1 service advertises the CRS extension and EPSG:3857 output, so this candidate uses server-side horizontal reprojection rather than requiring local EPSG:27700 support.
The configured 2 m spacing is a Web Mercator request/cache grid, not native source resolution. Across England this corresponds to approximately 1.1-1.3 m ground spacing.
WCS metadata reports native coverage bounds [80000, 4000, 656000, 665000], 1 m native spacing, coverage axes E/N and grid axes i/j.

Live probes on 2026-09-19 require uppercase X/Y subset axes for EPSG:3857 and i/j scaling axes. Native E/N subset names or X/Y scaling names return HTTP 500. TSRE configures subset and scaling axes separately.
The service's official NoData value is -3.4028235e+38. Zero is a valid terrain elevation and zeroIsNoData must remain false.
The source covers approximately 99% of England rather than every cell inside the rectangular bounds; normal HGT fallback should remain available for gaps.

Bounds are conservative EPSG:3857 request bounds. Server reprojection expands requested envelopes: a 1026 x 1026 response had approximately 2.10 map m spacing. allowExpandedGrid validates coverage of requested pixel centres and limits expansion to 10% per edge; sampling uses the actual TIFF transform, never a relabelled 2 m grid.

datasets.name: Estonia - Maa- ja Ruumiamet DTM 1 m (2 m request grid)
datasets.attribution: Republic of Estonia Land and Spatial Development Board - Elevation data
notes: Native source is the nationwide 1 m DTM in EPSG:3301 (L-EST97), with heights in EH2000 / EVRS.
WCS 1.0 server-side reprojection to EPSG:3857 has been independently verified. This avoids requiring local EPSG:3301 Lambert Conformal Conic support.
The configured 2 m spacing is a Web Mercator request/cache grid. At Estonian latitudes it corresponds to approximately 1.0-1.1 m ground spacing, closely matching the native 1 m DTM.

Live probes on 2026-09-19 confirmed FORMAT=GeoTIFF returns an XML InvalidParameterValue error with HTTP 200. requestFormat=image/tiff selects the accepted spelling; a 514 x 514 response has exact 2 map m spacing and fractional Float32 heights. Existing WCS 1 services retain their default GeoTIFF alias.
The official WCS endpoint also supports WCS 2.0.1 with coverage dtm-1; server-side CRS behavior through that path has not yet been verified for TSRE.
No authentication is required.
Zero is a legitimate coastal/sea-level elevation and may be returned without a NoData marker, so zeroIsNoData must remain false.
Bounds are conservative EPSG:3857 bounds covering Estonia; actual coverage follows the national territory.

datasets.name: Denmark - DHM/Terrain (1 m)
notes: National DHM/Terrain is a LiDAR-derived bare-earth terrain model on a native 0.4 m grid in ETRS89 / UTM zone 32N (EPSG:25832). Heights are DVR90 (EPSG:5799; compound CRS EPSG:7416).

Datafordeler requires authentication. For API-key access the key is supplied as the query parameter apikey. TSRE resolves geo.elevation.dk.datafordeler.apiKey from profile-local secrets.json and adds it only to the outgoing request. Public URLs and cache metadata omit the key.

The official WCS examples request FORMAT=GTiff; requestFormat configures that spelling independently of the TIFF decoder. The request/cache grid is 1 m, resampled by the server from native 0.4 m terrain.
Official WCS examples confirm coverage dhm_terraen, CRS/RESPONSE_CRS EPSG:25832 and numeric GeoTIFF output.

Authenticated probes on 2026-09-19 confirmed exact 1 m Float32 TIFF grids (32 x 32 and 1026 x 1026). A full 256 x 256 terrain grid produced 65536 source samples with no HGT fallback, using nine downloaded blocks; repeating used cache only. Bounds are conservative and broader national/coverage-edge validation remains open.
Zero and slightly negative DVR90 elevations are valid in Denmark, so zeroIsNoData must remain false.

datasets.name: Belgium - Flanders DHMV II DTM 1 m (2 m request grid)
datasets.attribution: Digitaal Vlaanderen - DHMV II DTM 1 m
notes: Native DHMV II DTM is a 1 m LiDAR-derived bare-earth terrain model. Heights are expressed in metres TAW (Tweede Algemene Waterpassing).
This entry uses WCS 1.0 server-side reprojection to EPSG:3857, which TSRE already supports. No Belgian Lambert projection support is required.

The configured 2 m spacing is a Web Mercator request/cache grid, not the native raster resolution. At Flemish latitudes this corresponds to roughly 1.25 m ground spacing and avoids materially oversampling the native 1 m source.
WCS 1.0 with FORMAT=GeoTIFF is known to return a direct numeric GeoTIFF. WCS 2.0.1 also exists but commonly returns multipart/related GML + TIFF, so WCS 1.0 is the simpler TSRE path.
The source NoData value is -9999. Zero is a valid terrain elevation in coastal and polder areas, so zeroIsNoData must remain false.
Bounds are conservative EPSG:3857 bounds derived from the published Flanders + Brussels coverage envelope; actual coverage is not rectangular.
DHMV II was surveyed in 2013-2015. The dataset is complete but should be described as historical terrain rather than current-year elevation.
